brief: What is the latest assessed polypropylene price in Southeast Asia?

sections.title: Latest Assessed Polypropylene Price in Southeast Asia
questions: What is the most recent assessed price for polypropylene (PP) in Southeast Asia?
Are there any gaps or limitations in the latest available price data for this product and region?
sections.tool_rationale: 'describe_corpus' will confirm the coverage and any gaps in the PP|Southeast Asia CFR|Spot price series; 'query_price_series' will retrieve the latest available assessed price and highlight any missing or blank values.
sections.unanswerable_if: If the PP|Southeast Asia CFR|Spot price series does not contain any non-blank price for the most recent months (i.e., July and August 2026), the latest assessed price cannot be provided.

excluded.topic: Price forecast or outlook for polypropylene in Southeast Asia
excluded.reason: The corpus and the ASEAN Petrochemical Monitor explicitly state that price forecasts or outlooks are not published or available.
